sloka: सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः ।तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.२६.४७ ॥
transliteration: sā vai niḥśvasamānā tu vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ ।tasmai sarvaṁ yathātattvamākhyātumupacakrame ।। 7.26.47 ॥

translations.english: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.
